==Usage==
{{Tl|LesserEvilMap}} renders as {{LesserEvilMap}}. It is intended to be used in &lt;ref&gt; notes, like such:

<pre><ref name="Lesser Evil map">{{LesserEvilMap}}</ref></pre>

'''Colonial Station Chaf''' was a terrestrial astronomical object within the territory of the [[Chiss Ascendancy]] in the [[Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Lesser Evil map">{{LesserEvilMap}}</ref>
